items.statement: The reported optimized neutral singlet structures for both named systems are stationary-point minima, supported by frequency analysis with no imaginary modes.
items.expected: Both 4a and 4c have auditable minimum validation. Incomplete checks receive only supported process/partial credit, not credit for a validated minimum.

items.statement: The two central monocyclic five-membered pentalene rings are individually identified and each NICS probe is placed 1.7 Å normal to its centroid with a stated orientation and sign convention.
items.expected: Ring-resolved probe construction is auditable and the molecular value is the mean of the two ring values.

items.statement: The computed NICS(1.7)zz for 4a is strongly positive and near the paper's reported endpoint value.
The computed NICS(1.7)zz for 4c is strongly positive and near the paper's reported endpoint value.
